jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
The Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Director
to lead multiple product engineering teams
responsible for building and evolving Linktree’s core user-facing experiences. This role is for a product-first engineering leader who cares deeply about craft, velocity, and customer impact — and who knows how to scale teams while continuing to ship high-quality product.

You’ll partner closely with Product and Design leadership to turn strategy into execution, guide technical direction across teams, and ensure we consistently deliver beautiful, performant, and reliable experiences to millions of users. This is not a platform or infrastructure-focused role — it’s about shipping product
, growing leaders, and raising the bar for how we build.

What You’ll Do

Own engineering execution and outcomes across multiple product engineering teams.
Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and senior ICs, building a strong leadership bench and healthy team culture.
Set technical direction and standards for user-facing systems, balancing long-term quality with delivery speed.
Partner deeply with Product and Design to shape roadmaps, define scope, and translate product vision into shippable plans.
Drive delivery excellence, ensuring teams prioritize effectively and consistently deliver high-impact work.
Guide architectural decisions for front-end and full-stack systems with a pragmatic, product-minded approach.
Champion quality, performance, and reliability, including testing strategy, operational readiness, and on-call health.
Leverage AI to accelerate both delivery and product impact from developer tooling and workflows to AI-powered product experiences that drive user value.
Communicate clearly with stakeholders and executives, surfacing progress, risks, and tradeoffs early and thoughtfully.
Navigate ambiguity and shape strategy in evolving product areas, defining the engineering approach where the playbook doesn't yet exist.

Who You Are

Proven experience leading multiple product engineering teams in a product-led, consumer-facing environment.
Strong technical foundation in modern web development and architecture (TypeScript, React, GraphQL, AWS).
Deep understanding of how to ship and scale user-facing products with a high bar for UX, performance, and polish.
Comfortable operating across levels — from org design and strategy to critical technical and delivery decisions.
Strong instinct for connecting engineering execution to business metrics — you think in terms of conversion, retention, and revenue impact, not just shipping features.
A collaborative, empathetic leader with strong cross-functional communication skills.
Delivery-oriented with excellent instincts for prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoff management.
Thrives in ambiguous, high-opportunity spaces where the strategy is still being shaped.
Curious and AI-forward, actively using automation and LLM tools to boost team effectiveness.

Nice to Have

Experience building products for creators, small businesses, or independent sellers — particularly around helping them grow or monetize.
Exposure to commerce, subscription systems, or monetization surfaces.
Track record of scaling teams through periods of rapid product growth while maintaining quality.

Linktree is committed to providing a fair and competitive compensation package including cash, equity, and benefits. The base salary offered for this role is targeted at $300,000- $325,000 for roles based in San Francisco and Los Angeles. Final offers depend on multiple factors including location, experience, expertise, and role scope, and may vary from the range listed.

P.S. If you don’t tick every box in this listing, please don’t rule yourself out. We take pride in inclusion and hiring incredible human beings with great potential over ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, hit that apply button!

Our Story

We’re on a mission to empower anyone to curate, grow, and monetize their digital universe. We created the “link in bio” category — and we’re just getting started. From creators, artists, and entrepreneurs to global brands, we’re redefining how people connect with their communities, showcase their content and promote products — all in one link.

Today, a community of 70+ million use Linktree, including icons like Adidas, TikTok, the UN Environmental Program, The NFL, Manchester United, World Central Kitchen, Sabrina Carpenter, Olivia Rodrigo, and Selena Gomez. With 48,000 new accounts created every day, Linktree is the fastest-growing leader in our space.

We’ve teamed up with some of the world’s biggest platforms including TikTok, Snap, YouTube, GoFundMe, Spotify, Google, Stripe, Reddit, Laylo, and Kajabi, to unify Linkers’ digital spaces, and we partner with retail brands Amazon, Nike, Nordstrom Target, Sephora, Vuori, and more to share products they love.

We’re a tight-knit, passionate team building best-in-class tools that make online presence simple, powerful, and yours. If you're excited by the idea of shaping a new category, setting the standard, and making space for everyone to be seen and succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Where And How We Work

We're a global, diverse team spread across continents with offices in London, Los Angeles, Melbourne, and San Francisco. We work together flexibly and you can choose the setup that works best for you: fully remote or a hybrid mix of office and home.

We offer autonomy in how you structure your days and weeks. While we’re mindful of time zones and occasionally collaborate outside the typical 9–5, we lean into async work to keep things flowing. Our culture is family-friendly and Zoom-casual where kids, pets, and delivery drivers are welcome.

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Our approach to benefits considers the whole person and the unique contributions they bring to Linktree. We want the experience at Linktree to be one that enables people to truly thrive so we can Go Further Together (one of our values). Some ways we support you:

An annual wellbeing allowance to use on things like (but not limited to) fitness memberships, development courses, childcare, travel, charitable donations, pet insurance, home office set-up - the choice is yours!
100% coverage (and 80% for your dependents) of your monthly premiums for medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance for US-based employees.
Employer contribution towards your retirement.
Generous time off for vacation, holidays, parental leave, volunteer time, and other categories.
Employee stock option program - we want each and every employee to share in the company’s success.

At Linktree, we believe in promoting a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, talents, and experiences, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and has equal opportunities to thrive. We aim to foster a diverse and inclusive environment where all team members have a sense of belonging. Linktree welcomes all people regardless of sex, gender identity, race, ethnicity, disability, pregnancy, age, or other lived experience. If you require accommodations to fully participate in our opportunities, please don't hesitate to reach us at talent@linktr.ee – your needs are important to us.

Meet the Team

The CX AI Incubation and Agent team builds breakthrough solutions across delivery intelligence, network automation, and edge computing for Cisco Customer Experience (CX) and our global customers. We partner across engineering, product, and design to develop scalable, responsible platforms leveraging Generative and Agentic AI. Join an inclusive, high-impact team pushing the boundaries of AI innovation to solve critical enterprise challenges.

Your Impact

As an engineering leader in Cisco CX, you will define and execute the technical strategy for AI solutions that transform customer adoption and renewals. You will lead high-performing engineering teams from concept to production, operationalizing autonomous agents, context engineering, and multi-agent orchestration platforms. In this role, you will combine deep technical architecture with business strategy to deliver production-grade AI systems at scale.

What You’ll Do

Drive engineering Delivery: Spearhead end-to-end development of agentic AI solutions across the CX customer adoption and renewals portfolio.
Architecture and platform: Lead architecture and build core platform to host Agentic solutions.
Lead Engineering Teams: Manage and mentor cross-functional teams of software, ML, and data engineers and technical leaders through full lifecycle delivery.
Standardize Tech Stack: Evaluate, select, and standardize tools, frameworks, and foundation model infrastructure across the portfolio.
Align Cross-Functionally: Partner with product management and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into production AI applications.
Set Engineering Standards: Establish best practices for responsible AI, context engineering, and observable agent deployment.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field with 15+ years of software engineering experience (or Master’s degree with 12+ years).
5+ years of engineering management experience leading software and ML engineering teams.
Experience programming in Python, Java, C++, or modern object-oriented languages.
Experience building and scaling data-driven AI/ML systems, AI-native applications, and AI agents, including agent harnesses and production-grade agentic architectures.
Experience building and deploying systems utilizing LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, or Agentic AI architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or Machine Learning.
Experience architecting multi-agent orchestration pipelines and context engineering systems.
Experience applying AI solutions to enterprise customer success, adoption, or renewal workflows.
Proven track record of technical leadership and cross-functional execution in fast-paced environments.
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams and executive business leaders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Director of Solid State Science & API Engineering (SSAE), Material Analytical Science
jobs.description:
Description

The Director of SSAE, Material and Analytical Sciences (MAS) provides strategic, scientific and managerial leadership of the SSAE Group within the MAS Department. Material and Analytical Sciences screens, develops, and applies innovative, state-of-the art scientific methods and tools, in-silico and digital solutions, that facilitate development of drug substance, drug product and overall process understanding and robustness, thereby enabling successful development of a highly diverse and complex first-in class portfolio of NCE (New Chemical Entity) and NTM (New Therapeutical Modality) pipeline assets in Candidate Selection (CS) relevant characterization and early to late CMC development stages. A focus is on the development and application of modelling & simulation tools to accelerate and streamline development of DS and DP (predict first - confirm later). MAS works with the global Development functions (DEV NCE and DEV Biologicals), as well as Operations and Animal Health where applicable. The Director of SSAE ensures that the group meets the qualitative and quantitative goals and standards as defined by the international and local Development CMC requirements. This role develops talent through effective and agile mentorship and assignments, and continuously develops the group, including hiring of skills and competencies needed to successfully drive Boehringer’s global development portfolio.

As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and opportunity to directly contribute to the Company’s success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim´s high regard for our employees.
Duties & Responsibilities

• Provides leadership and technical guidance in ensuring drug substance and drug product deliverables, and provision of expert consultation across global business units, in particular global Development CMC and Operations, , etc.
• Builds networks and actively manages key interfaces, stakeholders and customers across the development functions and beyond.
• Collaborates effectively with global SMEs & leaders across disciplines and sites.
• Develops and implements innovation strategies that enhance scientific and business value of MAS and extend its scope of influence within BI.
• Develops talent by mentoring to grow capabilities and responsibilities.
• Recruits, retains and develops high-quality staff.
• Participates in interdisciplinary and/or international Boehringer Ingelheim projects as requested by BIPI and international senior management.
• Initiating, executing, and driving initiatives for the Department or wider organization as applicable.
• Ensures compliance with all required training, safety, regulatory, HR, laboratory notebook, intellectual property, GMP´s and GLP´s (where applicable), and corporate ethics and policies.
• Ensures high visibility and influence of the department with outside organizations including academic institutions, regulatory agencies and industrial/academic associations.
• Develops budgetary requirements for projects and laboratory operations, manages and adjusts activities to operate within budgetary goals.
Requirements

• Ph.D. degree or equivalent with focus on pharmaceutical relevant science (esp. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering) with ten plus (10+) years of industrial or academic experience, including managing groups of more than ten (10) individuals.
• Proven ability to manage, lead, and motivate others.
• Ability to propose creatively and independently, articulate, evaluate and drive innovations that bring value through improving efficiency and effectiveness in DS and DP development (such as process understanding).
• Demonstrated broad and in-depth understanding of pharmaceutical and/or analytical sciences in internal and external scientific communities.
• Extended technical experiences with API crystallization, API/ intermediate isolation, and process development, plus amorphous formulation development.
• Extensive knowledge on NCE/ NTM DS and DP development in various stages from pre-candidate selection till launch.
• Proven track record of driving innovations and applying cutting-edge scientific principles in development of robust, efficient processes and formulations, analytical methods, in silico and digital tools and technologies/concepts that expand capabilities beyond the current state.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with, negotiate and influence business partners in CMC Development and other business functions (Operations, etc.).
• Demonstrated ability to lead/ drive and participate in interdisciplinary and/or international teams.
• Effective communication, coaching, and negotiating skills.
• Existing alliances with academia and relevant external scientific bodies.
• Demonstrated ability to prepare technical reports, publications and oral presentations both to scientists (internally and externally) and senior level management.
• Ability to manage all aspects of group operations and critical components of departmental operations.
• Understanding of, and compliance with, all applicable regulations and BI business procedures.

Eligibility Requirements

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.
• Must be willing to take a drug test and post-offer physical (if required).
• Must be 18 years of age or older.
Compensation Data

This position offers a base salary typically between $230,400.00 and $345,600.00 USD. The position may be eligible for a role specific variable or performance based bonus and or other compensation elements. For an overview of our benefits please click here .

Our Company

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com.

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon brings together exceptional builders who take ownership, drive meaningful impact, and shape what's next for the web. We power more than 300,000 websites globally for organizations including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, Clorox, and the United Nations. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers use our WebOps platform to build, iterate, and scale WordPress, Drupal, and Next.js sites that reach billions of people worldwide. As an employer, we operate with the same philosophy that drives our product: foundation and freedom. Pantheon is a vibrant, remote-forward team of experts who care deeply about their craft and results. Here, you take ownership of work that matters, contribute alongside exceptional people, and see the impact you create.

The Role

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Customer Runtimes, you will lead and manage a sizable team of talented software engineers focused on building the scaled infrastructure services that run the high-impact Drupal, Wordpress, and Next.js sites of our customers. The team is driving an exciting transformation of our most core customer infrastructure to expand our capabilities, leverage best of breed open source technologies, and significantly reduce toil. jobs.description:
About Charge

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (one-fifth of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we developed robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables. We’ve shipped our first commercial system already, and are in the process of scaling up our operations to meet our massive demand.

Charge is a fast-moving company, which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with 🤖 giant robots 🤖.

If you are excited to work on interesting technical problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems
MIT News - Making solar projects cheaper and faster with portable factories
YouTube - full video of our Gen1 robots building a solar farm

Charge’s funding:

We’re MIT-founded and backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Founders Fund, Energy Impact Partners, Lux Capital, YC (S21), and more.

About The Role

Charge Robotics is hiring a Head of Engineering to lead the engineering team through our next stage of growth: transitioning from first commercial deployments to repeatable builds and performance at scale. You will lead a 15+ person, cross‑disciplinary team and stay hands-on where needed to keep execution fast and technical quality high.

What you will do

Report directly to the CEO in order to lead, mentor, and grow an all-star, multi-disciplinary engineering team
Collaborate closely with company leadership to align the strategic direction of engineering initiatives with company goals and roadmap
Be a critical part of driving the design of our product while architecting the team structure and engineering processes required to bring it to deployed reality
Scale engineering operations from R&D through manufacturing, leading the transition from prototype development to full production
Internally and externally represent the engineering function of the organization to key stakeholders including employees, customers, executives, and investors
Establish and continuously improve engineering management processes, including performance reviews, planning, and organizational design
Set the bar for excellence across engineering activity, including implementing best practices for development, testing, and documentation
Continuously learn new industry best practices and emerging technologies

As Head of Engineering at Charge Robotics, you’ll have a wide and critical impact which includes shaping our core technical team, expanding our existing culture of engineering excellence, creating effective processes, and helping ship a transformative product. You'll engage with internal and external teams to help ensure we’re successful in achieving our mission of creating a better way to build solar power.

You

Gain satisfaction from personally playing a part in mitigating climate change
Have excellent verbal and written communication skills
Have excellent interpersonal relationship management skills
Have 5+ years of experience in an engineering leadership role
Have overseen multiple development cycles end-to-end and shipped complex electromechanical systems
Can roll up your sleeves to dive into a problem when needed, but maintain context of broader organizational goals and perspective
Are strongly opinionated but know how and when to compromise effectively
Are versed in walking the careful balance between shipping quickly and shipping quality
Operate effectively in the fast-paced environment of a rapidly growing startup
Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field
Are based in or can relocate to the SF Bay Area, and able to work 4-5 days/week from our San Leandro HQ
Are open to ~10% travel to field (solar construction sites) to work directly with our product in its deployment environment
Are excited to see our robots deployed onto actual solar farms!

It’d also be nice if you

Have extensive experience developing automation and robotics systems
Have experience working with solar power generation technologies
Have experience working directly in multiple different engineering disciplines

The annual base salary range for this position is from $180,000 to $300,000. The actual base pay offered will be determined on factors such as years of relevant experience, skills, education and training. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.description:
About Sesame Workshop

Sesame Workshop is the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street and so much more. For over 50 years, we have worked at the intersection of education, media, and research, creating joyful experiences that enrich minds and expand hearts, all in service of empowering each generation to build a better world. Our beloved characters, iconic shows, outreach in communities, and more bring playful early learning to families in more than 190 countries and advance our mission to help children everywhere grow smarter, stronger, and kinder. Learn more at www.sesame.org and follow Sesame Workshop on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and X.

Job Summary

The Director, Production Technology is a member of the Technology & Engineering department and reports to the Vice President, Production Technology. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The Director provides technical and project leadership through deep subject-matter expertise, cross-functional influence, and ownership of complex production technology initiatives.

Purpose

The Director, Production Technology leads the architecture, modernization, and operational effectiveness of Sesame Workshop’s production and post-production technology ecosystem. This role translates production and creative needs into scalable technology solutions, owns major infrastructure and platform initiatives, establishes and drives adherence for technology standards, and helps shape the long-term production technology roadmap. The role is responsible for the reliability and scalability of critical hardware and software platforms used across the creative teams.

The Director serves as a senior technical partner to Production, Creative, and Technology & Engineering teams, balancing creative ambition, usability, cost, reliability, security, and scalability across the content lifecycle. The role also evaluates emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, and provides informed recommendations on where new capabilities can meaningfully improve Sesame Workshop’s production model.

Responsibilities & Delivery

Delivery

Lead the design, integration, and evolution of end-to-end production and post-production workflows, ensuring efficient and scalable handoffs across the content lifecycle.
Manage the post-production shared storage environment, editing software, and remote editing solutions, and lead technical execution of related infrastructure upgrades.
Formalize studio, virtual, and live production procedures, including control room operations, and plan infrastructure and equipment upgrades across studio, field, and post-production environments.
Evaluate emerging production and post-production technologies, including AI-driven applications, and define the department’s point of view on where they change the production and post-production operating model.
Shape the long-term strategy for media asset management, archive, and distribution systems, and build the automated QC pipelines that support them.
Own the technical administration, integration, and evolution of production collaboration, file transfer, and cloud-based media workflow platforms, currently including Frame.io, Signiant, and LucidLink.
Manage capital budget planning and spend for production technology purchases, and maintain detailed documentation of workflows, systems, and process changes.
Establish standards for reliability, security, access, lifecycle management, backup, and business continuity across production and post-production systems.
This role may perform other related duties as needed to support team and organizational priorities

Engagement

Support production and creative teams as their day-to-day technology partner, engaging directly to resolve workflow and equipment needs.
Collaborate with Technology & Engineering peers in IT, Digital Media Engineering, and Project Management on cross-team workflow integrations.
Build and maintain relationships with vendors, systems integrators, contractors, and production crews to support studio, field, and post-production needs.
Represent Production Technology in vendor evaluation and discovery discussions, advocating for solutions that fit the department's technical direction.
Partner with the VP, Production Technology to shape the department's multi-year technology roadmap.
Brief and train technical and non-technical team members on new workflows, systems, and process changes.
Provide senior technical and project leadership across complex initiatives, establishing direction, driving alignment, and coordinating work across internal teams and external partners without direct reporting authority.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years of experience in production or post-production technology, media engineering, or a related field.
Significant hands-on experience with production and post-production technology and complex media workflows, with a track record of owning projects from discovery through documentation and handoff.

About The Role

As the Director of Carrier Development
within our Supply and Marketplace
division, you will own the strategic evolution, capacity procurement, and growth of our carrier network. You will be directly responsible for navigating macro-market volatility, optimizing marketplace health, and driving deep carrier engagement across Truckload, LTL, and Intermodal networks.

This is a highly collaborative, relationship-driven leadership role. You must be a business strategist who can seamlessly bridge the gap between internal business priorities and external carrier capabilities—building high-trust internal networks to deeply understand customer demands while empowering your team to work side-by-side with carriers to grow their businesses.

Key Responsibilities

Carrier Development & Strategic Partnerships

Mutual Growth Initiatives: Collaborate deeply with strategic carrier partners to understand their business objectives, aligning Uber Freight’s marketplace volume to help them scale effectively.
Value Creation: Architect and execute joint business strategies that deliver mutual benefits—maximizing benefit for carriers while locking in dedicated capacity for Uber Freight.
Carrier Advocacy: Serve as an internal champion for the carrier community, partnering with product and operations teams to build programs that reduce friction, improve the carrier experience, and position Uber Freight as a preferred partner.
Network Synergy: Identify network-level patterns and multi-shipper synergies to unlock structural savings, optimize carrier routing, and drive continuous marketplace efficiency.

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

Scale & Inspire: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of Carrier Development Managers across our strategic hubs, fostering an analytical, collaborative, and partnership-driven culture.
Team Enablement: Provide strategic direction to your team of Carrier Development Managers as they work to expand carrier accounts, unlock mutual benefits, and secure capacity commitments.
Marketplace Roadmaps: Establish clear team roadmaps and supply strategies aligned with Uber Freight’s overarching financial and marketplace goals.
Executive Presence: Act as a visible thought leader, presenting multi-modal capacity, supply economics, and partnership strategies to enterprise shipper executives and internal senior leadership.

Internal Alignment & Stakeholder Management

Cross-Functional Bridges: Build strong, quality relationships across internal teams—including Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Product—to stay deeply attuned to changing shipper demands and broader commercial business needs.
Demand-to-Supply Translation: Translate internal business insights, pipeline developments, and shipper challenges into actionable carrier development and capacity sourcing strategies.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the primary conduit between commercial teams and the carrier network to proactively solve capacity constraints and execution bottlenecks.
Product Collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to accelerate the development of carrier technology to better integrate carriers into the Uber Freight Network.

Carrier Development vs. Acquisition

Carrier Development

This role is focused on the post-onboarding lifecycle—deepening relationships, maximizing mutual value, and scaling the existing carrier network.

Scaling Existing Wallet Share: Managing and expanding existing strategic carrier accounts to increase their volume and secure dedicated, long-term capacity commitments.
Strategic Planning: Designing and executing joint business strategies centered on maximizing benefits, lane optimization, and asset utilization for both the carrier and Uber Freight.
Internal Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborating heavily with internal commercial teams (Sales, Account Management, Operations) to deeply understand shipper demands and match them with active carrier capabilities.
Long-Term Network Stickiness: Acting as an internal carrier advocate to Product and Engineering teams to improve technology integration, automated booking adoption, and overall carrier retention.
Strategic Performance Management: Conducting high-level Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on multi-year growth paths, performance tracking, and continuous network efficiency.

Carrier Acquisition (Sourcing)

This role is focused entirely on the top-of-funnel pipeline—finding un-networked carriers, cold outreach, vetting, and initial setup.

Top-of-Funnel Pipeline Growth: Aggressively identifying and targeting new, un-networked carriers to expand the raw capacity footprint of the marketplace.
Outbound Sourcing Strategy: Leading a team focused on high-volume outbound prospecting, digital marketing campaigns, and cold-calling initiatives to attract new fleets.
Frictionless Onboarding and Activation: Overseeing the end-to-end initial setup process, removing administrative roadblocks to ensure rapid time-to-activation from initial contact to the first booked load.
Strict Initial Compliance Gatekeeping: Partnering heavily with Risk, Safety, and Legal teams to rigorously vet new carriers against FMCSA, DOT, and internal insurance thresholds before they enter the network.
Targeted Regional Deficit Sourcing: Analyzing marketplace data to identify specific regional capacity deficits or lane-level gaps, then directing sourcing efforts to target carriers in those precise geographies.
Introductory Procurement Setup: Establishing introductory pricing baselines, spot-market behavior expectations, and contract templates for newly onboarded carriers during their trial periods.

Basic Qualifications

Experience: 8–10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, 3PL, digital brokerage, supply chain procurement, or carrier management.
Leadership: 5+ years of direct people management experience leading high-performing teams, with specific experience managing Carrier Development Managers, relationship managers, or carrier procurement professionals.
Market Expertise: Deep operational fluency across North American, with an intimate understanding of carrier cost drivers, supply economics, and macro market cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

Relationship Management: Proven track record of managing executive-level carrier relationships and driving joint business planning (JBP) or carrier success initiatives.
Network Synergy: Demonstrated ability to look across fragmented supply chain networks to identify, capture, and unlock structural efficiencies and multi-shipper synergies that drive asset utilization.
Internal Influence: Exceptional emotional intelligence (EQ) and a demonstrated ability to navigate matrixed organizations, building highly effective internal partnerships to understand and solve business needs.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a highly analytical field.
Technical Fluency: Advanced proficiency in data-analytics tools (Tableau, SQL, or Google Workspace) with a proven track record of converting raw shipping data into strategic pricing and capacity models.
Modal Expertise: Experience navigating multiple transportation sectors, including Truckload (TL), Less-than-Truckload (LTL), Intermodal, Bulk, and Flatbed.

The Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Director
to lead multiple product engineering teams
responsible for building and evolving Linktree’s core user-facing experiences. This role is for a product-first engineering leader who cares deeply about craft, velocity, and customer impact — and who knows how to scale teams while continuing to ship high-quality product.

You’ll partner closely with Product and Design leadership to turn strategy into execution, guide technical direction across teams, and ensure we consistently deliver beautiful, performant, and reliable experiences to millions of users. This is not a platform or infrastructure-focused role — it’s about shipping product
, growing leaders, and raising the bar for how we build.

What You’ll Do

Own engineering execution and outcomes across multiple product engineering teams.
Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and senior ICs, building a strong leadership bench and healthy team culture.
Set technical direction and standards for user-facing systems, balancing long-term quality with delivery speed.
Partner deeply with Product and Design to shape roadmaps, define scope, and translate product vision into shippable plans.
Drive delivery excellence, ensuring teams prioritize effectively and consistently deliver high-impact work.
Guide architectural decisions for front-end and full-stack systems with a pragmatic, product-minded approach.
Champion quality, performance, and reliability, including testing strategy, operational readiness, and on-call health.
Leverage AI to accelerate both delivery and product impact from developer tooling and workflows to AI-powered product experiences that drive user value.
Communicate clearly with stakeholders and executives, surfacing progress, risks, and tradeoffs early and thoughtfully.
Navigate ambiguity and shape strategy in evolving product areas, defining the engineering approach where the playbook doesn't yet exist.

Who You Are

Proven experience leading multiple product engineering teams in a product-led, consumer-facing environment.
Strong technical foundation in modern web development and architecture (TypeScript, React, GraphQL, AWS).
Deep understanding of how to ship and scale user-facing products with a high bar for UX, performance, and polish.
Comfortable operating across levels — from org design and strategy to critical technical and delivery decisions.
Strong instinct for connecting engineering execution to business metrics — you think in terms of conversion, retention, and revenue impact, not just shipping features.
A collaborative, empathetic leader with strong cross-functional communication skills.
Delivery-oriented with excellent instincts for prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoff management.
Thrives in ambiguous, high-opportunity spaces where the strategy is still being shaped.
Curious and AI-forward, actively using automation and LLM tools to boost team effectiveness.

Nice to Have

Experience building products for creators, small businesses, or independent sellers — particularly around helping them grow or monetize.
Exposure to commerce, subscription systems, or monetization surfaces.
Track record of scaling teams through periods of rapid product growth while maintaining quality.

Linktree is committed to providing a fair and competitive compensation package including cash, equity, and benefits. The base salary offered for this role is targeted at $300,000- $325,000 for roles based in San Francisco and Los Angeles. Final offers depend on multiple factors including location, experience, expertise, and role scope, and may vary from the range listed.

P.S. If you don’t tick every box in this listing, please don’t rule yourself out. We take pride in inclusion and hiring incredible human beings with great potential over ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, hit that apply button!

Our Story

We’re on a mission to empower anyone to curate, grow, and monetize their digital universe. We created the “link in bio” category — and we’re just getting started. From creators, artists, and entrepreneurs to global brands, we’re redefining how people connect with their communities, showcase their content and promote products — all in one link.

Today, a community of 70+ million use Linktree, including icons like Adidas, TikTok, the UN Environmental Program, The NFL, Manchester United, World Central Kitchen, Sabrina Carpenter, Olivia Rodrigo, and Selena Gomez. With 48,000 new accounts created every day, Linktree is the fastest-growing leader in our space.

We’ve teamed up with some of the world’s biggest platforms including TikTok, Snap, YouTube, GoFundMe, Spotify, Google, Stripe, Reddit, Laylo, and Kajabi, to unify Linkers’ digital spaces, and we partner with retail brands Amazon, Nike, Nordstrom Target, Sephora, Vuori, and more to share products they love.

We’re a tight-knit, passionate team building best-in-class tools that make online presence simple, powerful, and yours. If you're excited by the idea of shaping a new category, setting the standard, and making space for everyone to be seen and succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Where And How We Work

We're a global, diverse team spread across continents with offices in London, Los Angeles, Melbourne, and San Francisco. We work together flexibly and you can choose the setup that works best for you: fully remote or a hybrid mix of office and home.

We offer autonomy in how you structure your days and weeks. While we’re mindful of time zones and occasionally collaborate outside the typical 9–5, we lean into async work to keep things flowing. Our culture is family-friendly and Zoom-casual where kids, pets, and delivery drivers are welcome.

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Our approach to benefits considers the whole person and the unique contributions they bring to Linktree. We want the experience at Linktree to be one that enables people to truly thrive so we can Go Further Together (one of our values). Some ways we support you:

An annual wellbeing allowance to use on things like (but not limited to) fitness memberships, development courses, childcare, travel, charitable donations, pet insurance, home office set-up - the choice is yours!
100% coverage (and 80% for your dependents) of your monthly premiums for medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance for US-based employees.
Employer contribution towards your retirement.
Generous time off for vacation, holidays, parental leave, volunteer time, and other categories.
Employee stock option program - we want each and every employee to share in the company’s success.

At Linktree, we believe in promoting a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, talents, and experiences, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and has equal opportunities to thrive. We aim to foster a diverse and inclusive environment where all team members have a sense of belonging. Linktree welcomes all people regardless of sex, gender identity, race, ethnicity, disability, pregnancy, age, or other lived experience. If you require accommodations to fully participate in our opportunities, please don't hesitate to reach us at talent@linktr.ee – your needs are important to us.

Description

The Director of SSAE, Material and Analytical Sciences (MAS) provides strategic, scientific and managerial leadership of the SSAE Group within the MAS Department. Material and Analytical Sciences screens, develops, and applies innovative, state-of-the art scientific methods and tools, in-silico and digital solutions, that facilitate development of drug substance, drug product and overall process understanding and robustness, thereby enabling successful development of a highly diverse and complex first-in class portfolio of NCE (New Chemical Entity) and NTM (New Therapeutical Modality) pipeline assets in Candidate Selection (CS) relevant characterization and early to late CMC development stages. A focus is on the development and application of modelling & simulation tools to accelerate and streamline development of DS and DP (predict first - confirm later). MAS works with the global Development functions (DEV NCE and DEV Biologicals), as well as Operations and Animal Health where applicable. The Director of SSAE ensures that the group meets the qualitative and quantitative goals and standards as defined by the international and local Development CMC requirements. This role develops talent through effective and agile mentorship and assignments, and continuously develops the group, including hiring of skills and competencies needed to successfully drive Boehringer’s global development portfolio.

As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and opportunity to directly contribute to the Company’s success. new_jobs.description:
KPMG is building a product organization designed to help transform decades of industry experience into innovative, software-powered businesses. Backed by the scale, resources, and market presence of a global network, this organization operates with the energy, ambition, and pace of a startup. We are assembling a founding team of builders, innovators, and problem solvers who are excited by the opportunity to create new products, shape new ways of working, and help define the future of technology-enabled business at KPMG. If you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, embrace ambiguity, and are motivated by the potential to make a lasting impact from the ground up, we invite you to consider joining us on this journey.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Platform Product Management to join our Product organization.

Responsibilities:

Shape the multi-year platform strategy and integrated roadmaps for an AI-native platform across multiple complex domains, aligning product, technology, and firm priorities
Own the capability inventory and assessment across advisory and relevant functions, identifying recurring workflows, agents, data models, and integrations that should become reusable platform assets — and harvest the best of them into the shared platform in collaboration with our engineering organization
Lead cross-domain recommendations on shared versus product-specific capabilities and build, buy, partner, or harvest options for senior product and technology leaders
Advise engineering and architecture leaders on cross-platform architecture and integration decisions, prioritize technical debt, and ensure reusable capabilities meet scalability, reliability, security, regulatory, and technical standards
Resolve major roadmap, dependency, reuse, and investment trade-offs across platform domains and product teams, using customer needs, technical feasibility, critical gaps, and platform value to guide decisions
Set platform adoption and reuse measures, using build-time, cost, reliability, and product-team outcomes; Drive internal adoption through evangelism, documentation and developer experience; Coach professionals and advance technical product-management practices across teams
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum ten years of recent experience in product management for technical products or platforms, including owning a B2B or enterprise platform product end to end
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Minimum of a high school GED is required; Minimum of twelve years of equivalent professional experience is required
Proven experience shaping platform strategy across complex technical products, platforms, or processes with results in platform adoption, cross product reuse, delivery speed, cost, or customer outcomes; experience in a complex or regulated environment is preferred
Deep technical product management experience, including product lifecycle management, cross-product prioritization, analytics and experimentation, and defining non-functional requirements (NFRs) and service level objectives (SLOs). Demonstrated fluency in application programming interfaces (APIs), data models, AI and agent frameworks, integration patterns, and technical debt trade-off decisions
Demonstrated daily use of AI across working practice, and platforms or products that have shipped or shaped where AI and agent frameworks were core rather than decorative; ability to guide shared versus product-specific capability decisions and develop build, buy, partner, or harvest recommendations
Ability to operate with limited oversight, advise senior product and technology leaders, resolve complex cross-platform trade-offs, and coach professionals in leading technical product-management practices; preferred experience with developer or internal platforms (i.e. Agent orchestration, connector and integration architecture, or governed AI tooling) with audit trails and human-in-the-loop controls with application, data, or legacy modernization tooling

The Director, Production Technology is a member of the Technology & Engineering department and reports to the Vice President, Production Technology. As the Director of Carrier Development
within our Supply and Marketplace
division, you will own the strategic evolution, capacity procurement, and growth of our carrier network. This is a highly collaborative, relationship-driven leadership role. You must be a business strategist who can seamlessly bridge the gap between internal business priorities and external carrier capabilities—building high-trust internal networks to deeply understand customer demands while empowering your team to work side-by-side with carriers to grow their businesses.

Key Responsibilities

Carrier Development & Strategic Partnerships

Mutual Growth Initiatives: Collaborate deeply with strategic carrier partners to understand their business objectives, aligning Uber Freight’s marketplace volume to help them scale effectively.
Value Creation: Architect and execute joint business strategies that deliver mutual benefits—maximizing benefit for carriers while locking in dedicated capacity for Uber Freight.
Carrier Advocacy: Serve as an internal champion for the carrier community, partnering with product and operations teams to build programs that reduce friction, improve the carrier experience, and position Uber Freight as a preferred partner.
Network Synergy: Identify network-level patterns and multi-shipper synergies to unlock structural savings, optimize carrier routing, and drive continuous marketplace efficiency.

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

Scale & Inspire: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of Carrier Development Managers across our strategic hubs, fostering an analytical, collaborative, and partnership-driven culture.
Team Enablement: Provide strategic direction to your team of Carrier Development Managers as they work to expand carrier accounts, unlock mutual benefits, and secure capacity commitments.
Marketplace Roadmaps: Establish clear team roadmaps and supply strategies aligned with Uber Freight’s overarching financial and marketplace goals.
Executive Presence: Act as a visible thought leader, presenting multi-modal capacity, supply economics, and partnership strategies to enterprise shipper executives and internal senior leadership.

Internal Alignment & Stakeholder Management

Cross-Functional Bridges: Build strong, quality relationships across internal teams—including Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Product—to stay deeply attuned to changing shipper demands and broader commercial business needs.
Demand-to-Supply Translation: Translate internal business insights, pipeline developments, and shipper challenges into actionable carrier development and capacity sourcing strategies.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the primary conduit between commercial teams and the carrier network to proactively solve capacity constraints and execution bottlenecks.
Product Collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to accelerate the development of carrier technology to better integrate carriers into the Uber Freight Network.

Carrier Development vs. Acquisition

Carrier Development

This role is focused on the post-onboarding lifecycle—deepening relationships, maximizing mutual value, and scaling the existing carrier network.

Scaling Existing Wallet Share: Managing and expanding existing strategic carrier accounts to increase their volume and secure dedicated, long-term capacity commitments.
Strategic Planning: Designing and executing joint business strategies centered on maximizing benefits, lane optimization, and asset utilization for both the carrier and Uber Freight.
Internal Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborating heavily with internal commercial teams (Sales, Account Management, Operations) to deeply understand shipper demands and match them with active carrier capabilities.
Long-Term Network Stickiness: Acting as an internal carrier advocate to Product and Engineering teams to improve technology integration, automated booking adoption, and overall carrier retention.
Strategic Performance Management: Conducting high-level Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on multi-year growth paths, performance tracking, and continuous network efficiency.

Carrier Acquisition (Sourcing)

This role is focused entirely on the top-of-funnel pipeline—finding un-networked carriers, cold outreach, vetting, and initial setup.

Top-of-Funnel Pipeline Growth: Aggressively identifying and targeting new, un-networked carriers to expand the raw capacity footprint of the marketplace.
Outbound Sourcing Strategy: Leading a team focused on high-volume outbound prospecting, digital marketing campaigns, and cold-calling initiatives to attract new fleets.
Frictionless Onboarding and Activation: Overseeing the end-to-end initial setup process, removing administrative roadblocks to ensure rapid time-to-activation from initial contact to the first booked load.
Strict Initial Compliance Gatekeeping: Partnering heavily with Risk, Safety, and Legal teams to rigorously vet new carriers against FMCSA, DOT, and internal insurance thresholds before they enter the network.
Targeted Regional Deficit Sourcing: Analyzing marketplace data to identify specific regional capacity deficits or lane-level gaps, then directing sourcing efforts to target carriers in those precise geographies.
Introductory Procurement Setup: Establishing introductory pricing baselines, spot-market behavior expectations, and contract templates for newly onboarded carriers during their trial periods.

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Nutanix is seeking a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Customer Success Platform, a strategic internal product that powers customer success, professional services, renewals, sales, product, and corporate strategy teams.

This platform serves as the centralized source of customer adoption, engagement, and business insights across Nutanix, enabling data-driven decision-making from frontline teams to executive leadership. Insights generated through the platform directly inform regular C-suite business reviews and strategic initiatives.

In this role, you will own product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and roadmap definition through launch, adoption, and optimization. You will work closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, data teams, and engineering partners to deliver scalable capabilities that drive user engagement, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

A key aspect of this role is shaping our AI strategy, including developing intelligent virtual adoption agents, AI-powered insights and capabilities, and automation capabilities that transform how users interact with the platform.

The ideal candidate combines strong product execution skills with strategic thinking, excels at working across functions, and uses data to drive product decisions and measurable outcomes.

About The Team

The Customer Success Platform team builds the systems, experiences, and insights that help Nutanix maximize customer adoption and business growth. Our platform serves as the strategic foundation for understanding customer health, adoption trends, renewal readiness, and growth opportunities across the customer lifecycle.

We operate as a highly collaborative product organization, partnering closely with Engineering, Data, UX, Customer Success, Professional Services, Renewals, Sales, and Corporate Strategy teams. Our work directly influences operational execution, executive decision-making, and company growth initiatives.

This is a high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape both the product strategy and AI vision for a platform that impacts teams across Nutanix.

Your Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Define and execute the roadmap for Nutanix's Customer Success Platform, aligning investments with business objectives and user needs.
Drive product strategy across customer success, professional services, renewals, sales, product, and corporate strategy functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve operational efficiency, and deliver business value through technology and automation.

AI & Innovation

Lead the platform's AI roadmap, including virtual adoption agents, intelligent recommendations, and personalized user experiences.
Champion the use of AI and automation to increase productivity, user engagement, and business impact.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate them into high-value product capabilities.

Product Development & Execution

Partner with stakeholders to uncover challenges, gather requirements, and identify product opportunities.
Translate business needs into product requirements, user stories, and prioritized backlogs.
Collaborate closely with UX and engineering teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and impactful solutions.
Own the product lifecycle from ideation and development through launch and ongoing optimization.
Lead UAT activities and ensure solutions meet business and user expectations.

Analytics, Adoption & Business Impact

Define success metrics and measure product performance through usage, engagement, adoption, and business outcome KPIs.
Leverage analytics, experimentation, and user feedback to continuously improve platform effectiveness.
Create executive-ready insights, reports, and recommendations for senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.
Develop release communications, training programs, and enablement materials that drive adoption and long-term value realization.

Stakeholder Engagement

Build strong partnerships across business, engineering, UX, and data teams.
Communicate product vision, roadmap, and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Present new capabilities and drive awareness, adoption, and organizational alignment.

What You Will Bring

5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or business applications.
Proven experience defining product strategy and delivering end-to-end software products.
Experience launching AI-powered capabilities such as virtual agents, copilots, recommendations, or intelligent automation.
Demonstrated ability to gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into product roadmaps and prioritized delivery plans.
Experience partnering with UX, engineering, and data teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.
Strong analytical skills with experience using product analytics, experimentation, customer journey analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
Experience managing product launches, user acceptance testing, adoption measurement, and post-launch optimization.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including experience supporting executive-level decision-making.
Experience working in Agile product development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with customer success, CRM, analytics, partner, learning management, commerce, or business productivity platforms.
Familiarity with software licensing, subscriptions, renewals, and customer lifecycle management.
Experience supporting enterprise software adoption, customer success, professional services, or recurring revenue business models.
Understanding of enterprise application ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, learning platforms, incentive management, commerce systems, data lakes, data warehouses, and analytics solutions.
Experience building or managing unified data platforms and single-source-of-truth business systems.
Deep familiarity with AI-driven user experiences, personalization, automation, and conversational interfaces.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role at this time.

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 160,000 and USD $ 320,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
